subject.why: Clearly depicts the requested townhouse with all required architectural features.

category.why: The pavement slab ends abruptly on the sides, leaving the structure floating.

clean.why: No text, UI, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The roof and upper floor are cut off at the top margin.

colour.why: Palette is warm, saturated, and separates cleanly from the blue sky.

detail.why: Shapes and brickwork are suitably chunky without noisy micro-details.

style.why: Rendered with smooth volumes and satin sheen matching the references.

fix: Zoom out to fit the full roofline within the frame and extend the pavement fully across the bottom edge.
